confirmations_requested.ask: Call the Central area chief to confirm whether LH-02 is actually stopped at TJ-C512-04 (radio says stopped, CMMS says operating). No loader moved there until confirmed.

decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at E595-06 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 13:30. The stope holds 256 t at 15.4 g/t, about 127 oz, and is worth about 15 oz per loader hour at the LH410 rate of 30 t/h. Este trucks have room (inflow 36 against 72 t/h capacity). LH-08 comes from the cheap infrastructure heading DS-C512-01 (1.9 oz/h) and takes 0.53 h to travel. LH-09 would cost 4.0 oz/h on the critical-path heading, so it is not used. Estimate: about 6.4 loading hours at 30 t/h is roughly 190 t, or about 95 oz. Lost development is about 14 oz. Net is about 70-80 oz. LH-02 is left alone under CONFIRM-01 until the area chief confirms its status. LH-10 is not available until 11:00.
